Definition: from Φιλάδελφος (the same as G5361), a king of Pergamos; Philadelphia, a place in Asia Minor:--Philadelphia.
BiblicalUsage: Philadelphia is a city in Asia Minor, one of the seven churches of Revelation, and its name means brotherly love. The risen Christ writes to the church there as the one who has the key of David, and He sets before them an open door that no man can shut.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Philadelphia's open door is the promise to a little-strength church that kept His word: a door no man can shut, for a people who did not deny His name.
